svg.title: Partial sums of the Maclaurin series for e to the x
svg.desc: The graph of y = e to the x from x = -3 to 2.5 with the first three Taylor polynomials about 0: the line 1 + x, the parabola 1 + x + x squared over 2, and the cubic that adds x cubed over 6. Each new term brings the polynomial closer to e to the x over a wider stretch; at x = 2 their values are 3, 5 and about 6.333, approaching e squared, about 7.389.

text.tspan: The partial sums of 1 + x + x²/2! + x³/3! + ⋯ close in on eˣ.
At x = 2: 3, 5, 6.333, ... approaching e² ≈ 7.389. The series converges to eˣ for every x.
